<translated_code>
import sys
import math

def ms(s, n):  # Not needed, ignore
    pass

def FOR(i, a, b):
    return range(a, b)

def FORd(i, a, b):
    return range(a - 1, b - 1, -1)

# bitcount using built-in bin(x).count('1')
def bitcount(x):
    return bin(x).count('1')

# __builtin_popcountll
def popcountll(x):
    return bin(x).count('1')

# __lg: floor(log2(x))
def lg(x):
    return x.bit_length() - 1

def gcd(a, b):
    while b:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

def lcm(a, b):
    return a // gcd(a, b) * b

def fpow(n, k, p):
    r = 1
    while k:
        if k & 1:
            r = r * n % p
        n = n * n % p
        k >>= 1
    return r

def chkmin(a, val):
    if val < a[0]:
        a[0] = val
        return 1
    return 0

def chkmax(a, val):
    if a[0] < val:
        a[0] = val
        return 1
    return 0

def isqrt(k):
    r = int(math.isqrt(k)) + 1
    while r * r > k:
        r -= 1
    return r

def icbrt(k):
    r = int(round(k ** (1/3))) + 1
    while r * r * r > k:
        r -= 1
    return r

def addmod(a, val, p):
    a[0] = (a[0] + val) % p
    # if a >= p: a -= p (but mod handles)
    return

def submod(a, val, p):
    a[0] = (a[0] - val) % p
    # if a < 0: a += p
    return

def mult(a, b, p):
    return (a * b) % p

def inv(a, p):
    return fpow(a, p - 2, p)

def sign(x, eps=1e-9):
    return -1 if x < -eps else (1 if x > eps else 0)

def sign_xy(x, y):
    return sign(x - y)

def transform(arr, n, p, invert):
    k = lg(n)
    for i in range(k):
        for msk in range(n):
            if (msk >> i) & 1:
                pmsk = msk ^ (1 << i)
                if not invert:
                    arr[msk] = (arr[msk] + arr[pmsk]) % p
                else:
                    arr[msk] = (arr[msk] - arr[pmsk]) % p

def pow_convol(a, k, p):
    n = len(a)
    if k == 1:
        return a[:]
    elif k & 1:
        r = pow_convol(a, k - 1, p)
        res = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n - i):
                res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + r[i] * a[j]) % p
        return res
    else:
        r = pow_convol(a, k >> 1, p)
        res = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n - i):
                res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + r[i] * r[j]) % p
        return res

def subset_pow_convol(a, k, p):
    logn = 19
    n = len(a)
    while n != (n & -n):
        n += n & -n
    res = [0] * n
    fa = [[0] * n for _ in range(logn)]
    fc = [[0] * n for _ in range(logn)]
    for i in range(logn):
        for j in range(n):
            if bitcount(j) == i:
                fa[i][j] = a[j] if j < len(a) else 0
            else:
                fa[i][j] = 0
            fc[i][j] = 0
        transform(fa[i], n, p, 0)
    for i in range(n):
        va = [fa[j][i] for j in range(logn)]
        va = pow_convol(va, k, p)
        for j in range(logn):
            fc[j][i] = va[j]
    for i in range(logn):
        transform(fc[i], n, p, 1)
        for j in range(n):
            if bitcount(j) == i:
                res[j] = fc[i][j]
    return res

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    p = int(data[2])
    nn = n
    f = [0] * (n + 1)
    # iterate i from 0 to n where (n & i) == i
    # Optimize: iterate over submasks of n
    sub = n
    while True:
        i = sub
        if (n & i) == i:
            t = 0
            for j in range(20):
                if (n >> j) & 1:
                    t <<= 1
                    t |= (i >> j) & 1
            f[t] = i
            if i == 0:
                break
            nn = t  # This will become max t
        sub = (sub - 1) & n
        if sub == n:
            break
    if n & 1:
        sys.stdout.write(str(fpow(k, n, p)) + "\n")
        return
    maxn = 1000005
    fac = [1] * (maxn)
    for i in range(1, maxn):
        fac[i] = mult(fac[i-1], i, p)
    ifac = [0] * maxn
    for i in range(maxn):
        ifac[i] = inv(fac[i], p)
    a = [0] * (nn + 1)
    for i in range(nn + 1):
        a[i] = ifac[f[i]]
    res = fpow(k, n, p)
    a_conv = subset_pow_convol(a, k, p)
    submod_val = mult(a_conv[nn], fac[n], p)
    res = (res - submod_val) % p
    sys.stdout.write(str(res) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
